issues.title: Files land in Android/data workspaces, not in the Documents root
issues.detail: The required root is /storage/emulated/0/Documents/OpenCode/<project>. Some chats wrote to storage/emulated/0/Android/data/<app>/files/workspaces/<n>/, others to Documents/OpenCode/mobile-N. Owner: file root is OK for now.

issues.title: MCP Refresh did not load an opencode.json the model wrote
issues.detail: Refresh only re-read GET /mcp from the running instance, and upstream builds MCP state once per instance from cfg.mcp. So a server written into opencode.json stayed invisible until a restart. D2 worked because it used POST /mcp, which changes the running instance directly. Fix: refreshMcp() disposes the idle instance (same remedy as the permission policy) and then re-reads; while a turn runs it skips dispose and asks the user to refresh after the turn.

issues.title: Commands cannot run scripts or .bin shims under Documents/OpenCode
issues.status: fixed on phone (owner, 2026-10-31, 17:12 screenshot): in Documents/OpenCode/mobile-11, ./t.sh ran (sh fallback) and node_modules/.bin/hello ran under Node v24.22.1 (bin cmd ran OK: v24.22.1). Built by CI run 41199211096.
issues.detail: Phone 11:20: npx works, but its .bin shim fails (exit 126), then npm install --no-bin-links rea-agents was started and the owner stopped it. Phone 11:41: pwd is /storage/emulated/0/Documents/OpenCode/mobile-10; touch t.sh, chmod +x, ./t.sh gives Permission denied. Shared storage is noexec. Workaround candidates that do not change the root: run MCP entries as node <path-to-entry> (not via npx or .bin); and a brief change that tells models this. The brief is 829/830 words, so a change needs another part trimmed. Owner 2026-10-30: shims must work in every path; users usually pick their own folder. Decision: MCP and tool packages install under the app home ($HOME/tools/<name>, exec-allowed), run through node; the shared-storage root is unchanged.
